welcome.headline: Make room for what matters.
welcome.intro: A space for notes, plans, and everything you want to remember. Simple files, kept where you choose.
welcome.folderHint: Markdown files and attachments stay in your folder.

markdown.title: Plain Markdown
markdown.description: Your notes stay as simple files you can open anywhere.

workspace.title: Your workspace
workspace.description: Choose a folder you already use, or create a new one.

private.title: Private by design
private.description: Your notes live on your device and remain in your control.

workspace-missing.title: Workspace not found
workspace-missing.message: Your last workspace folder could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted. Open a folder to continue.

workspace-unavailable.title: Workspace unavailable
workspace-unavailable.message: Your last workspace folder could not be opened. Check that it still exists and that Basalt may access it, then open a folder again.

empty.title: No notes yet
empty.description: Notes you create are saved as Markdown files in this folder.

workspace.watchFallback: The list refreshes when the window is focused.

noNote.title: No note open
noNote.description: Select a note from the list to start writing.

unavailable.title: The workspace folder is not available
unavailable.message: The folder was deleted or renamed. Your text is kept here and saving is paused.

openError.title: This note could not be opened
openError.too-large: Notes over 5 MiB are not opened in the editor. The file is never changed.
openError.not-utf8: This file is not UTF-8 text, so Basalt does not open it. The file is never changed.
openError.symlink: This note is a symbolic link. Basalt does not follow symbolic links, so it is not opened and never changed.
openError.unknown: An unknown error stopped Basalt from opening this note. The file is never changed.

confirmReload.title: Load the version from disk?
confirmReload.message: Your unsaved changes in "{name}" will be lost.

confirmClose.title: Close this note?
confirmClose.message: "{name}" was deleted or moved. Your unsaved changes will be lost.

saveError.title: Could not save the note
saveError.message: {reason} Your text is kept here and saving is paused.

conflict.title: This note changed on disk
conflict.message: Another program changed this file while you had unsaved edits. Saving is paused until you choose.

deleted.title: This note was deleted or moved
deleted.message: The file is no longer in the workspace. Saving is paused so it is not recreated by accident.

errors.not-found: The file or folder could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.permission-denied: The workspace folder is read-only. Nothing was changed.
errors.already-exists: A file with this name already exists.
errors.invalid-path: This name or location is not valid.
errors.conflict: This note was changed on disk by another program.
errors.too-large: This note is too large to open.
errors.not-utf8: This file is not a UTF-8 text file and cannot be opened.
errors.unavailable: The workspace folder is not available. Check that it still exists.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
